200.description: The API is available.
Whether a campaign is currently accepting public registrations.

201.description: The registration was saved and, on a best-effort basis, a verification email was sent. A 201 does not guarantee the email arrived — see POST /v1/registrations/:id/resend-verification.

409.description: Either no campaign is currently open for registration (error code CONFLICT), or this email already has a registration for the open campaign (error code ALREADY_REGISTERED) — check the response body's error.code to tell them apart.

413.description: The request body is too large.

415.description: The request body is not JSON.

422.description: The request did not match the registration schema.

500.description: The registration could not be saved.

200.description: Always returned, whether or not a new verification email was actually sent — see the route's doc comment.

get.description: What an email link naturally is: GET with the token as a query param.

200.description: The email is verified; the registration moved from pending_email to pending_review. This does NOT create a membership.

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used. Deliberately generic — never distinguishes those cases from each other or from a nonexistent registration.

post.description: What a client-side confirmation page might prefer: POST with the token in the body, so it doesn't sit in server logs / browser history.

200.description: The email is verified; the registration moved from pending_email to pending_review. This does NOT create a membership.

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, or already used. Deliberately generic — never distinguishes those cases from each other or from a nonexistent registration.

get.description: The VAPID public key the admin PWA needs to create a push subscription. Fetched at runtime so no key is compiled into the browser bundle. Empty string when push is not configured on the server. Requires the `admin.access` capability.

200.description: The VAPID public key, or an empty string.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Register (or refresh) this browser's push subscription for the signed-in admin. Idempotent on the endpoint. Requires `admin.access`.

200.description: The subscription is stored.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Drop this browser's push subscription. Idempotent. Requires `admin.access`.

200.description: The subscription is gone.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

get.description: Dashboard counts for the current campaign plus the current / registration-open campaign refs for the header. Requires the `admin.access` capability.

200.description: Counts and campaign context.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

get.description: Requires the `registrations.review` capability. campaignId is required so omitting it can never list across every campaign at once.

200.description: Registrations for the given campaign.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

422.description: campaignId is missing or status is not a valid value.

get.description: One registration with its profile snapshot, the applicant's prior memberships, a new/returning classification and any duplicate registrations for the same email. Requires `registrations.review`.

200.description: The registration and its review context.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Move a rejected registration back to pending_review. Never goes straight to accepted. Requires `registrations.review`.

200.description: The registration is back in the review queue.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

409.description: The registration is not in the rejected state.

post.description: Requires the `registrations.review` capability. The reviewer is the session user.

200.description: Accepted: the membership was created. notificationSent is false if the acceptance email failed to send — the membership still stands either way.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

409.description: The registration is not in pending_review.

post.description: Requires the `registrations.review` capability. The reviewer is the session user.

200.description: Rejected. notificationSent is false if the rejection email failed to send — the rejection still stands either way.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

409.description: The registration is not in pending_review.

get.description: Campaigns with active-member and pending-review counts, newest membership start first. Paginated for a uniform table contract even though the set is small. Requires `campaigns.write`.

200.description: All campaigns, newest membership start first.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Create a draft campaign (all four dates required). Requires `campaigns.write`.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

409.description: The slug is already taken, or the date ranges are invalid.

patch.description: Edit a campaign. The slug can only change while it is a draft. Requires `campaigns.write`.

200.description: The campaign.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

409.description: Illegal edit (e.g. renaming a published campaign's slug).

post.description: Open or close public registration for this campaign. Opening it closes whichever other campaign was open, in one transaction. Requires `campaigns.rollover`.

200.description: The campaign.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Make this the current campaign, clearing the flag from whichever campaign held it, in one transaction. Requires `campaigns.rollover`.

200.description: The campaign.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Archive a campaign. Never deletes; clears both coexistence flags. Requires `campaigns.rollover`.

200.description: The campaign.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

get.description: Paginated, searchable member list. `q` matches name / surnames / email; `filter` is all | current | past. Requires `members.read`.

200.description: A page of members plus the total match count.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

get.description: One member: profile, every membership row with its campaign, and the full audit timeline. Requires `members.read`.

200.description: The member's profile and history.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

404.description: No member (member_profile row) with that user id.

post.description: End this member's current-campaign membership as `left`. Requires `members.status.write`.

200.description: The action was applied to the current-campaign membership.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

404.description: No member with that id, or no membership for them in the current campaign.

409.description: The membership is not in a state that allows this transition, or no campaign is current.

post.description: End this member's current-campaign membership as `kicked` (reason required) and revoke all their sessions. Requires `members.status.write`.

200.description: The action was applied to the current-campaign membership.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

404.description: No member with that id, or no membership for them in the current campaign.

409.description: The membership is not in a state that allows this transition, or no campaign is current.

post.description: Reactivate a `left` or `kicked` current-campaign membership. Requires `members.status.write`.

200.description: The action was applied to the current-campaign membership.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

404.description: No member with that id, or no membership for them in the current campaign.

409.description: The membership is not in a state that allows this transition, or no campaign is current.

patch.description: Promote or demote a member between `member` and `admin`. Writes a `role_changed` audit event, separate from membership changes. Requires `members.role.write`.

200.description: The member's new role.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

404.description: No member (member_profile row) with that user id.

get.description: Invitations for a campaign, `expired` computed at read time. Requires `invitations.write`.

200.description: Invitations for the campaign, newest first.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Invite someone to a campaign. Requires `invitations.write`, and `invitations.grant_admin` as well when intendedRole is admin. A non-udl.cat email needs allowExternalDomain: true.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

409.description: An invitation for this email + campaign already exists, or the email domain needs confirmation, or admin was requested without the capability.

post.description: Rotate the token on a pending invitation and email it again. Requires `invitations.write`.

200.description: A fresh link was sent.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Cancel a pending invitation and notify the invitee. Requires `invitations.write`.

200.description: The invitation was cancelled.

401.description: No session cookie, or the session is expired or revoked.

403.description: The session's role lacks the required capability, or the user has not completed onboarding.

post.description: Resolve an invitation token (in the body, never the query string) to the bound email, prefilled name, and campaign label. A generic 400 for any invalid / expired / used / unknown token.

200.description: The invitation is valid and pending.

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, cancelled, or used.

429.description: Too many lookups from this address.

post.description: Complete onboarding from an invitation. The email and campaign come from the token, never the body. Creates the account, profile, membership and the annual registration snapshot, then emails the welcome message.

200.description: Onboarding is complete. `alreadyMember` is true if the person was already a member (idempotent).

400.description: The token is invalid, expired, cancelled, or used.

429.description: Too many attempts from this address.
